const.nominalRadiusNote: The database has no radius for this body. The application uses a radius of 10 km for the picture and for the altitudes. This value is not a measured value.

picture.title: Picture of {body}

provenance.map: The surface comes from a map of images from a spacecraft or a telescope.
provenance.procedural: The application made this picture from a calculation. It is not an image from a camera.
provenance.mixed: The surface comes from a map of images. The application made some parts from a calculation.

note.surface-procedural: The application made the surface from a calculation. It is not an image from a camera.
note.glow-procedural: The application made the light around the Sun from a calculation.
note.clouds-procedural: The application made the clouds from a calculation.
note.haze-procedural: The application made the haze from a calculation.
note.atmosphere-procedural: The application made the atmosphere from a calculation.
note.bands-procedural: The application made the cloud bands from a calculation.
note.rings-procedural: The application made the rings from the published radii of the rings.
note.shape-approximate: The shape is approximate. It is not a measured shape model.
note.ring-width-exaggerated: The narrow rings show wider than they are.
note.ring-brightness-exaggerated: The dark rings show brighter than they are.
note.nucleus-only: The picture shows only the nucleus of the comet. It shows no coma and no tail.
note.surface-unknown: There are no spacecraft images of this surface.
note.body-unknown: This body is not in the body table. The picture shows an example of a small body.
note.rings-map: The color and the brightness of the rings come from an image.
note.ring-opacity-modelled: The image of the rings has no opacity data. The application calculates the opacity from the brightness.
note.rings-partly-procedural: The application made the ring parts that are not in the image.
note.no-data: A large part of the map has no data. This part shows dark gray.
note.no-data-small: A small part of the map has no data. This part shows dark gray.
note.no-data-north: Most of the area with no data is in the north.
note.no-data-south: Most of the area with no data is in the south.
note.map-edge-repaired: The map file had an incorrect column of pixels at its edge. The application replaced it with the adjacent column.
note.map-pole-repaired: The map file had an incorrect row of pixels at a pole. The application replaced it with the adjacent row.
note.colour-enhanced: The colors of the map are stronger than the colors that a person sees.
note.colour-near-natural: The map comes from filters for visible light. It is not an accurate copy of the colors that a person sees.
note.map-gaps-filled: Areas of the map with no image data have a mean color. These areas do not come from images.
note.colour-muted: The application shows the map with less color. The result is nearer to the colors that a person sees.
note.colour-synthetic: The map has no measured colors: its colors come from a model.
note.monochrome: The map is gray. No color data is available.
note.near-infrared: The map shows near-infrared light, not visible light.
note.radar: The map is a radar image.
note.surface-plain: The map of the surface is not available. The surface shows one color.
note.no-night-lights: The map of the night lights is not available.
note.no-clouds: The map of the clouds is not available.
note.variant-unavailable: The map of the surface below the atmosphere is not available. The picture shows the top of the atmosphere.
note.ring-map-without-radii: The image of the rings has no radius data. The application made the rings from the published radii.
note.ring-map-unused: The application made the rings from the published radii.
note.map-load-failed: A map file did not load. The application made the surface from a calculation.
note.night-map-load-failed: The map of the night lights did not load.
note.cloud-map-load-failed: The map of the clouds did not load.
note.ring-map-load-failed: The image of the rings did not load. The application made the rings from the published radii.

picture.earthClouds: The clouds come from one image. They do not show the weather of the date in view.
picture.nominalSize: The database has no size for this body. The picture uses a radius of 10 km.
